name: Kasaragod
source: Kerala Directorate of Survey and Land Records / Kerala Land Records Modernization Mission eMaps and Ente Bhoomi public land-record services

queries.query: Kasaragod Kerala official cadastral parcel map land records survey department
queries.result: Found first-party Kerala eMaps/Bhu-Naksha, Ente Bhoomi, Directorate of Survey and Land Records Kasaragod office listings, Kasaragod district revenue offices, and Kerala planning map material. The official cadastral viewers describe parcel sketches and land-record integration, but indexed pages did not expose a safe anonymous parcel API response.

queries.result: Malayalam discovery returned the official Ente Bhoomi Malayalam portal and Kerala survey/land-record references. The portal describes real-time land parcel maps and identifies Kasaragod digital-survey activity, but no safe anonymous ID-plus-geometry response was exposed.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Kerala Land Records Modernization Mission; Directorate of Survey and Land Records
officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: Kerala cadastral mapping and land-record integration; viewer advertises updated digital sketch for individual parcels
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: First-party indexed page identifies eMaps as a cadastral mapping application integrating spatial and textual land records. The public page exposes parcel-oriented map functionality but no downloadable anonymous feature endpoint in indexed content.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Government of Kerala Ente Bhoomi / Integrated Land Information Management System
officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: Kerala integrated land information and digital survey services
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Current first-party page was fetched successfully and states that land parcel maps and digital survey records are part of the system. Malayalam content specifically names Kasaragod district digital-survey rollout, but service access is login-oriented.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Kerala Directorate of Survey and Land Records
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official directory lists Survey Deputy Director, Re-Survey Assistant Director, District Survey Superintendent, Re-Survey Superintendent, and District Digitization Centre entries for Kasaragod. This establishes a local survey/land-record custodian; it does not itself provide parcel geometry.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Kerala Survey and Land Records / Ente Bhoomi
officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: Kasaragod digital-survey camp offices and villages
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official portal lists Kasaragod/Kasargode offices and villages including Kasaragod, Nekraje, Perumbala, and other survey-camp locations. It is administrative coverage evidence, not a parcel feature response.
